from typing import Literal
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

CaseType = Literal[
    "渎职罪",
    "行政行为-其他行政行为",
    "知识产权与竞争纠纷",
    "行政行为-行政许可",
    "危害公共安全罪",
    "行政行为-行政受理"
]

class DocumentAssignment(BaseModel):
    """One document with its assigned case type from the task's ordered list."""
    doc_title: str = Field(description="Document title or identifier, as named in the document")
    case_type: CaseType = Field(description="The assigned case type from the task's given list")
    justification: str = Field(description="Textual evidence from the document supporting the case type assignment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentAssignment]
